title: Ringing, green light and out-of-body feeling in the restroom during questioning
summary: Mario Woods tells of Ringing, green light and out-of-body feeling in the restroom during questioning, about 1960s at Missile site, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: toilet and all of a sudden Jesse I get this ringing in my ears that was as if somebody struck a Liberty Bell right next to my head

plain: Mario Woods, who served at a nuclear missile site in South Dakota in the 1960s, told podcast host Jesse Michels that during a period of questioning, linked to a Master Sergeant Gray, he went to the restroom. There, he says, he suddenly heard a ringing in his ears like a giant bell struck beside his head, saw a green light, and felt as if he had left his body, an experience that would suggest something unknown reaching into a nuclear base if true.
